Summer is here, and with it, comes the end of the "model year" for the major-brand running shoes that came out last August/September.

Keep your eyes peeled for the current model year shoes to go on clearance and show up in plenitude at outlet stores.

For example, the Nike LunarGlide. The current model is the LunarGlide 7, which came out in August 2015, and retails for $125.00. These will be replaced with a LunarGlide 8 in August or September. Nike will start sending their backstock to their Nike Outlet stores soon (if they're not already there) which tend to retail for $54.99-$89.99, depending on the color and style (the "shield" and "flash" varieties can differ a bit).

It's always good to have plenty of shoes in your rotation to even out the wear, so if you have room in your wallet and your closet, now is the time to snatch a new pair of your favorites for cheap.
